site.title: Production AI Patterns
site.tagline: A pattern language for AI that has to survive contact with production.
site.description: Named, reusable patterns for the architectural decisions that actually determine whether an AI system survives production traffic — context, cost, reliability, observability, and security.

articles.title: The Unbounded Memory Trap
articles.hook: Accumulated context isn't a superpower; it is an unpatched attack surface.

articles.title: Deaf at the Wheel
articles.hook: Model health ≠ outcome health. Your AI dashboards instrument the call, not the consequence.

articles.title: Reading the Pattern Language
articles.hook: How this catalog is organized, what a 'pattern' means here, and how to navigate from symptom to solution when your system is breaking in production.

articles.title: Circuit Breaker for Model Inference
articles.hook: When the model endpoint starts returning 500s or timing out, you need to stop hammering it. The circuit breaker adapted for LLM and embedding serving — with half-open recovery, fallback chains, and SLO-aware trip thresholds.

articles.title: The Cost Gate
articles.hook: Inference spend can spike orders of magnitude faster than traffic. The cost gate wraps high-cost model calls in a budget-aware gate that degrades gracefully instead of blowing up the billing dashboard at 2 AM.
